decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-30 MODIFY already captures the applicable high-level character direction and restraint; the specific treatment of additional letters remains owned by the letterform Requirement.
Applying the distinctive G treatment to more letters does not change the logo colour treatment; the separate colour clause in the same message is already represented.
The additional letterform treatment does not alter the strapline lines or contrast rules; the independent strapline colour decision is already represented.
The distinctive G-inspired treatment for other letters does not change the separate flame-based O symbol or its recognition requirement.
This revision to selected letterforms does not change the completed initial-concept task, originality expectation, or role of reference material.
The letterform styling request does not change the company name, exclusion of the word truck, or the logo's wider-business representation.
The request to add character to more letters does not change whether the existing strapline must be included.
The letterform refinement does not modify the requirement for fresh original artwork or the inspiration-only role of the AI-generated draft.
A change to letterform character does not alter the separate deliverable for documenting brand colours.
Refining custom logo letterforms does not necessarily change the separate obligation to provide complementary brand font guidance.
